description: Look at one Pulse check. view "status" (default) gives its settings and the latest state of each location, with the last error where it is failing. "failures" and "results" give single runs from the last 48 hours. "metrics" gives uptime and response times (average, p50, p95, p99) over a period.

hours.description: For metrics: the period in hours (default 24, max 2160)

limit.description: For results and failures: how many, newest first (default 20, max 500)

name: edge_get_pulse_check
